input: Research home exchange programs for next vacation

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Home exchange has distinct formats (simultaneous swap, non-simultaneous/points-based, hospitality exchange) — knowing which types to include or exclude shapes which platforms and listings to research.
The target destination or region dramatically narrows which platforms have relevant listings and what availability looks like.
The travel dates or timeframe determine urgency of the research and whether short-notice or advance-planning platforms are more relevant.
Platform membership fees vary widely; knowing whether cost is a concern affects which services to prioritise or dismiss.
Traveling solo, as a couple, or with children/pets changes which home sizes and exchange policies are needed, and which platforms cater to families.
Some people want a curated, vetted premium experience; others prefer a large open community — this determines which platforms to highlight and what features to compare.
The desired output of this research (a shortlist of platforms, a ready-to-submit listing, a booked exchange) defines where research ends and action begins.

gold.taskTitle: Research home exchange programs for next vacation
gold.taskDescription: Investigate home exchange platforms and options to plan an upcoming vacation using a home swap arrangement.

questions.title: Which type of home exchange interests you most?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a simultaneous swap (both parties exchange at the same time), a points-based non-simultaneous exchange, or is open to all formats.

questions.title: What destination or region are you hoping to visit?
questions.description: Identify the target travel destination or region to focus the platform and listing research on relevant inventory.

questions.title: When are you planning to travel for this vacation?
questions.description: Establish the intended travel window or timeframe to gauge research urgency and platform lead-time requirements.

questions.title: Are platform membership fees a concern for you?
questions.description: Understand the user's budget sensitivity toward annual or per-exchange platform costs, which vary from free to several hundred dollars.

questions.title: Who will be travelling with you on this trip?
questions.description: Clarify the travel party composition (solo, couple, family with children, pets) to match home size requirements and platform policies.

questions.title: Do you prefer a large open community or a curated vetted platform?
questions.description: Gauge whether the user values maximum listing volume or a more selective, trust-focused exchange network to prioritise the right platforms.

questions.title: What does a successful outcome of this research look like?
questions.description: Define the end goal — e.g., a ranked shortlist of platforms, a completed profile and listing, or a confirmed exchange booking — so research stops at the right point.
